theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tilt_height_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ : ℝ) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (r : ℝ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → Module.finrank ℝ S = n → ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ (r / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / r ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ r, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure + ENNReal.ofReal (κ ^ 2 * r ^ 2) * R.measure (closedBall ξ r))
